top.line: The timeline from a Web Summit newsroom to a data platform for Portugal's places in two weeks.

in-short.line: 4, 11, 15, 17 and 18 November: newsroom, storm, places, data site, a day of new sites and sources.

newsroom.line: The first commit at 00:08 on 4 November; the meter the next morning.

storm.line: The storm site live at 00:13 on 11 November; an agent per place on 15 November.

five.line: The data site live in a minute on 17 November, then four more sites in one request.

today.line: Events, a register of 92 sources, three new sources, new sites, cyber feeds cleared, licences on values.

security.line: Security review before and after every wake, hourly sweeps, a public log, 72 behaviour policies.

why.line: Each step left something the next used, so the cost of the next site keeps falling.

limits.line: Placeholders; cyber feeds cleared not collecting; commits are activity.

sources.line: The PrompTugal.news repository and sites, read 18 November 2026.
